_how_to_edit: This is the list of places the monthly update checks. To add a source, copy one block, change the name, url and use_for, and save. To pause a source without deleting it, set active to false. method: rss = reads the site's feed of new articles; page = reads the web page directly; search = the page blocks automated reading, so the run searches the web for that site's recent articles instead.
coverage: US Health Tech: startups building technology for healthcare, from AI diagnostics to tech-driven drug discovery

sources.name: STAT News
sources.use_for: Big health and biotech news, policy, FDA decisions. Many articles are paywalled (STAT+), so use headlines and summaries as signals, then confirm details elsewhere.

sources.name: Fierce Biotech
sources.use_for: Large trends and comparisons between big players: pharma deals, layoffs, clinical readouts, AI drug discovery.
sources.status: feed blocked and page returned old content; use web search for site:fiercebiotech.com

sources.name: Fierce Healthcare
sources.use_for: Health tech side of Fierce: payers, providers, digital health companies, AI in care delivery.
sources.status: works (feed is a bit messy, dates out of order)

sources.name: a16z Bio + Health
sources.use_for: New investments and theses from a top health tech VC. 'Investing in X' posts are early signals of who is getting funded.
sources.status: works, but posts show no dates; check each new name against the news

sources.name: Sequoia Stories
sources.use_for: Portfolio announcements and founder profiles. Mostly non-health, so only keep healthcare items.
sources.status: works, no dates, little healthcare content

sources.name: Crunchbase News: Health, Wellness and Biotech
sources.use_for: Funding rounds with amounts, investors and valuations. The weekly 'biggest rounds' roundup is the best single place to find new companies.

sources.name: PR Newswire: Health
sources.use_for: Company press releases announcing raises, launches and partnerships. Very noisy: only keep US health tech funding and product news.

sources.name: Rock Health
sources.use_for: The standard quarterly US digital health funding reports. Use for market-level numbers in the market take.
sources.status: page blocked; use web search for the latest Rock Health funding report

sources.name: Yahoo Finance
sources.use_for: Ticker watch only: stock prices of public health tech companies used as comparisons for the startups. Add the ticker to the end of the url.
sources.status: works, prices can lag a day or more; always print the date shown
